 APPLICATION UNDER ORDER 1 RULE 10 OF THE CIVIL PROCEDURE CODE, 1908, FOR STRIKING OUT DEFENDANT NO. 1 ZAMEEN.COM AS AN IMPROPERLY IMPLEADED PARTY 
 _______________________________________________________________________ _______ 
 
 It is respectfully submitted on behalf of the Defendant No. 01 as under: 
 
 Claim in the application 
 Titled application is being filed by Zameen Media (Private) Limited, a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan, operating as Zameen.com. The Applicant company has been impleaded as Defendant No.1, therefore, instant application for striking of the name of Defendant No.1 from array of parties in the titled suit is being filed through Mr. Syed Hasan Ali Shah who has been duly authorized in this behalf. 
 
 
 That the Plaintiff has instituted the above-titled suit for declaration, permanent and mandatory injunction, and the recovery of damages against the Defendants, i mpleading Zameen.co m (which in fact is merely a brand name and not a legal entity hence cannot be sued) as Defendant No. 1, and wrongly assum ed the Defendant No. 01 to be the owner or developer of the project known as “ Zameen Ace Mall.” The suit, as presently constituted, is legally untenable due to the erroneous inclusion of Zameen.com as Defendant No. 01 . 
 
 That this application is being submitted under Order 1 Rule 10 (2) of the Civil Procedure Code, 1908, which empowers this Honorable Court to strike out or add parties at any stage of the proceedings, either upon the application of either party or suo moto, on such terms as may appear to be just. This provision allows the Court to strike out any party improperly joined as a plaintiff or defendant and to add any person who ought to have been joined or whose presence before the Court is necessary for an effective and complete adjudication of the matter at hand. 
 
 That it is a well-established principle of law that only those parties should be impleaded in a suit who have a direct, substantial, and legal interest in the subject matter of the suit . Improper joinder of parties, particularly where a party has no legal standing or where its presence is not necessary for the adjudication of the dispute, leads to unnecessary complications, delays, and judicial inefficiency. In the instant case, Defendant No. 01 has been wrongly impleaded as a Defendant despite it not having any such direct or substantial interest in the project, and thus, its name ought to be struck off from the array of parties. 
 
 That Defendant No. 1, Zameen.com, is merely a brand name and a website owned and operated by Zameen Media (Pvt) Ltd. The Plaintiff, without proper inquiry, has wrongly assumed Zameen.com to be the owner or developer of the subject property, based solely on its role as a marketing agency. This erroneous belief is unfounded and devoid of any factual or legal basis. Zameen Media (Pvt) Ltd., operating under the brand name Zameen.com, is engaged in marketing services and has no ownership rights or direct involvement in the development, excavation or construction of the property known as “ Zameen Ace Mall.” 
 
 
 That it is evident that Defendant No. 01 i.e. Zameen.com has been improperly impleaded as a party to this suit. Its inclusion constitutes a misjoinder, which is in direct contravention of the principles governing proper joinder of parties under the Civil Procedure Code, 1908. Misjoinder of parties, especially one that has no direct involvement in the dispute, serves no purpose but to complicate the proceedings, waste the valuable time of this Honorable Court, and increase the burden on the defending parties. It is a well-settled principle of law that a suit is bad for misjoinder when a party is joined that has no legitimate or direct interest in the subject matter. 
 
 That c ontinuing the proceedings against Defendant No. 1 will not facilitate the just and complete adjudication of the present matter. On the contrary, it will only prolong the litigation, increase costs, and serve no purpose as no decree or effective order can be passed against a party that has no interest in the litigation. The principle of judicial economy and expedience warrants that this Honorable Court strikes out the name of Zameen.com from the array of Defendants at the earliest stage. 
 PRAYER 
 In light of the above, it is most humbly and respectfully prayed that this Honorable Court may be pleased to: 
 Strike out the name of applicant/ Defendant No. 1 from the array of parties in the present suit under Order 1 Rule 10 (2) of the Civil Procedure Code, 1908, as it has been wrongfully and improperly impleaded, and is neither a necessary nor a proper party for the resolution of this dispute . 
 
 Grant any other relief that this Honorable Court may deem fit and proper under the circumstances of the case, in the interests of justice. 
 
 
 DEFENDANT NO. 01 
 Zameen Media (Pvt) Ltd
